7.2.4.5.2 Rte_Rips_Write
[SWS_Rte_89021] Definition of API function Rte_Rips_<PlugIn>_Write_[<Swc
BswI>][Partition][_<ExE>]_<CGI>
Upstream requirements: SRS_Rte_00300, SRS_Rte_00301, SRS_Rte_00306, SRS_BSW_00310
⌈
Service Name
Rte_Rips_<PlugIn>_Write_[<SwcBswI>][Partition][_<ExE>]_<CGI>
Syntax
Std_ReturnType Rte_Rips_<PlugIn>_Write_[<SwcBswI>][Partition][_<Ex
E>]_<CGI> (
IN <data>,
[Std_TransformerError transformerError]
)
Service ID [hex]
0xEB
Sync/Async
Synchronous
Reentrancy
Reentrant
Parameters (in)
<data>
The IN parameter <data> pass the received data.
Parameters (inout)
None
Parameters (out)
transformerError
The OUT parameter transformerError contains the transformer
error which occurred during execution of the transformer chain.
Return value
Std_ReturnType
The return value is used to indicate communication errors.
Description
Rte_Rips_Write Performs an "explicit" write on a sender-receiver communication data element.
Available via
Rte_Rips_<PlugIn>_<SwcBswI>.h
⌋
Please note that the name part [_<ExE>] in the Rte_Rips_Write Service only ex-
ists in case of protection of explicitInterRunnableVariables.
